status: proposed continuous income approximation only; no finite-grid or household run
assumptions: Stationary annual persistent state, not Sommer zero initial state
Mean-one annual levels; deterministic age profile excluded from this covariance calculation
Applying wage risk to exogenous household earnings is a diagnostic proxy
No empirical re-estimation or preference calibration
income_definition: Z_t = (Y_4t + Y_4t+1 + Y_4t+2 + Y_4t+3)/4; four-year totals are 4 times the mean
objective: Sum of squared relative errors in mean-one level variance and autocovariances at 4, 8, 12, 16 years; equal weights, nonnegative component variances
